verdict: General name exclusion was overbroad; preserve names whose bare lemma resolves to an exact production lexeme.

implementation.resolution: Corpus production mapping ids plus the SecureChecker exact-formation gate; only pie-lex ids, never research-only ids or component-only prefix/base/preverb routes.

corpus_routes.sa-ep: live Sanskrit plus resolved av table, av decisions
corpus_routes.orv: Old Russian dictionary with Church Slavonic backoff and orv decisions
corpus_routes.icepahc: resolved icepahc table; historical Norse formation rules

implementation.content: Retained inherited names use the ordinary lemma and are content. Other annotated names receive (name) and are non-content. Explicit reviewed contextual name distinctions remain authoritative.
implementation.stage_c_loader: IcePaHC Stage C wrapper now delegates to the shared reviewed loader, with source forms requested explicitly.
implementation.limitations: EXACT is the production resolver classification, not a new exhaustive etymological review. Unreviewed exact homographs follow the requested gate; narrow reviewed exceptions and the complete frequency census are exposed below.

grc.πάτροκλος: Πάτροκλος is compound; the reviewed override lists πατήρ and κλέος as members, not whole-word matches.
grc.εὐρύκλεια: Εὐρύκλεια is compound; the reviewed override lists εὐρύς and κλέος as members, not whole-word matches.
grc.κλεάνωρ: Κλεάνωρ is compound; Kaikki's direct *ḱléwos link supplies only the first member.
grc.ζήνων: Ζήνων is a derivative personal name, not Ζεύς itself; its direct *dyḗws link loses the name suffix.
grc.ἀρκαδία: Ἀρκαδία is a derived place name, not the inherited word for bear; its *h₂ŕ̥tḱos link is a base.
grc.στέντωρ: Στέντωρ is an agent-name formation in -τωρ; *(s)tenh₂- is its derivational base.
grc.λύκος: Source-tagged Lycus (personal/place name), not the inherited common noun λύκος 'wolf'; wave-6 homograph review.
